name: thinkrail
description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
one_liner: An AI-powered code editor from JetBrains that learns your project's patterns over time and starts building its own tools to fit how you work.
buyer: A professional software team already paying for JetBrains tools who wants a more adaptive AI pairing experience without leaving that ecosystem.
business_use_cases: A dev team standardizes on it instead of piecing together separate AI plugins for their existing JetBrains workflow.
A consultancy adopts it early to market itself as ahead of the curve on agentic development to prospective clients.

money_ideas.idea: Revenue flows through JetBrains' own subscription and licensing, not to independent builders on top of it.

steal_this: There isn't much independently stealable here since it's a large vendor's incubator product; the real move is becoming an early power user and selling adoption consulting to teams evaluating it.
